- 1st: Liberal Bonnie Brown - 28,729 votes (52.01%)
- 2nd: Conservative Rick Byers - 19,524 votes (35.35%)
- 3rd: NDP Alison Myrden - **4,027 votes (7.29%)**

**The 2004 election had the biggest vote share difference between 1st and 3rd place at 44.72 percentage points.**

In that election, the runner-up (Conservative Rick Byers) received **19,524 votes**.
